places.name: Iguaçu National Park (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: Iguaçu National Park is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, home to the breathtaking Iguaçu Falls and diverse wildlife.
places.place_tip: Wear waterproof clothing and bring a camera with a protective case.
places.address: Iguaçu National Park, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Devil’s Throat Waterfall (Garganta del Diablo)
places.ai_summary: Devil’s Throat is the most dramatic section of Iguaçu Falls, where the water plunges into a narrow chasm, creating a thunderous roar and misty spectacle.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible via the park’s walking trails and viewing platforms.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid crowds and enjoy the best lighting for photos.
places.address: Devil’s Throat, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Parque das Aves (Bird Park)
places.ai_summary: Parque das Aves is a bird sanctuary near Iguaçu Falls, featuring a wide variety of exotic and endangered bird species in immersive enclosures.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the opportunity to walk through the aviaries and interact with the birds.
places.address: Parque das Aves, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Itaipu Dam
places.ai_summary: Itaipu Dam is a massive hydroelectric dam on the Paraná River, known for its impressive architecture and engineering, and is a UNESCO World Heritage site.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours only. Advance booking recommended.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the dam's history and operation.
places.address: Itaipu Dam, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Macuco Safari Boat Ride
places.ai_summary: Macuco Safari offers an exhilarating boat ride that takes you close to the Iguaçu Falls, providing a unique and thrilling perspective of the falls' grandeur.

opening_hours.notes: Wear appropriate clothing and expect to get wet.

places.place_tip: Book the boat ride in advance, especially during peak tourist season.
places.address: Macuco Safari, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Iguaçu River Rafting
places.ai_summary: Experience the thrill of rafting on the Iguaçu River, navigating through its rapids and enjoying the stunning scenery of the surrounding rainforest.
places.place_tip: Bring a change of clothes and secure your belongings in a waterproof bag.
places.address: Iguaçu River, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Helicopter Ride over Falls
places.ai_summary: A helicopter ride offers a breathtaking aerial view of the Iguaçu Falls and the surrounding rainforest, an unforgettable experience for visitors.
places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning aerial views.
places.address: Heli-Iguaçu, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Three Borders Landmark (Brazil–Argentina–Paraguay)
places.ai_summary: The Three Borders Landmark is where the borders of Brazil, Argentina, and Paraguay meet, marked by a monument and offering a panoramic view of the confluence of the three countries' rivers.
places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a better view of the river confluence.
places.address: Marco das Três Fronteiras, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Dreamland Wax Museum
places.ai_summary: Dreamland Wax Museum in Foz do Iguaçu features lifelike wax figures of celebrities, historical figures, and fictional characters, offering a fun and educational experience for visitors.
places.place_tip: Take your time to explore and take photos with the wax figures.
places.address: Dreamland Wax Museum, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Temple of Buddha
places.ai_summary: The Temple of Buddha in Foz do Iguaçu is a serene and beautifully landscaped area featuring a large statue of Buddha and offering a peaceful retreat for visitors.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Respect the local customs and enjoy the tranquility of the temple grounds.
places.address: Templo Budista, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Eco Museum Itaipu
places.ai_summary: The Eco Museum Itaipu is an environmental museum that educates visitors about the Itaipu Dam and the importance of sustainable development and conservation.
places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a tour of the Itaipu Dam.
places.address: Eco Museu Itaipu, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Parque das Cataratas Trail
places.ai_summary: The Parque das Cataratas Trail is a scenic walking trail in the Iguaçu National Park, offering stunning views of the Iguaçu Falls and the surrounding rainforest.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water.

places.place_tip: Start early to enjoy the trail with fewer people.
places.address: Parque Nacional do Iguaçu, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Trilha do Poço Preto Trail
places.ai_summary: The Trilha do Poço Preto is a hiking trail in the Iguaçu National Park that leads to a beautiful viewpoint of the Iguaçu Falls, known for its stunning scenery and biodiversity.

opening_hours.notes: Bring water and wear suitable hiking shoes.

places.place_tip: The trail can be muddy; consider bringing a walking stick.
places.address: Trilha do Poço Preto, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Iguaçu National Park Visitor Center
places.ai_summary: The Visitor Center at Iguaçu National Park provides essential information and services for visitors, including park maps, guided tour bookings, and educational exhibits about the park's ecology and conservation.
places.place_tip: Stop by the Visitor Center first to plan your visit and get the latest park information.
places.address: Centro de Visitantes, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Tancredo Neves Bridge View
places.ai_summary: The Tancredo Neves Bridge offers a panoramic view of the Iguaçu River and the surrounding area, and is a great spot for photography, especially at sunset.
places.place_tip: Be cautious while taking photos, as the bridge can be busy with traffic.
places.address: Ponte Tancredo Neves, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Itaipu Dam Night Show
places.ai_summary: The Itaipu Dam Night Show is a spectacular illumination of the dam and its surroundings, combined with a multimedia presentation about the dam's history and importance.
places.place_tip: Arrive early to secure a good viewing spot for the show.
places.address: Itaipu Dam, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Monjolo Park
places.ai_summary: Monjolo Park is a recreational area in Foz do Iguaçu, featuring walking trails, picnic areas, and a large waterfall, providing a peaceful escape into nature.

opening_hours.notes: Bring water and snacks, as there are limited facilities.

places.place_tip: Explore the walking trails and enjoy a picnic by the waterfall.
places.address: Parque Monjolo, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Shopping Catuaí Palladium
places.ai_summary: Shopping Catuaí Palladium is a modern shopping mall in Foz do Iguaçu, offering a wide range of shops, dining options, and entertainment facilities.
places.place_tip: Visit the food court for a variety of dining options.
places.address: Shopping Catuaí Palladium, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Feirinha de Foz Market
places.ai_summary: Feirinha de Foz is a popular market in Foz do Iguaçu, where visitors can buy local handicrafts, souvenirs, and enjoy delicious street food.
places.place_tip: Try the local street food and shop for unique souvenirs.
places.address: Feirinha de Foz, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil

places.name: Birdwatching Trail
places.ai_summary: The Birdwatching Trail in Foz do Iguaçu is a scenic trail that offers birdwatchers the chance to see a variety of bird species in their natural habitat, set in the beautiful landscape of the Iguaçu National Park.

opening_hours.notes: Bring binoculars and a bird guidebook.

places.place_tip: Be quiet and patient to increase your chances of spotting birds.
places.address: Trilha de Observação de Aves, Foz do Iguaçu - PR, Brazil
